conceptZh: 小太空人想摸巨型毛毛蟲頭上剛冒出的毛，卻浮過頭閃開了牠的衝撞，毛毛蟲一跤仰倒，震飛的四束毛落成「毛」字。
object: A tiny fishbowl-helmet astronaut toy, one giant round-segmented caterpillar, and four cobalt tufts.
morph: The belly-up thump sends four shaped tufts tumbling into the four strokes of 毛 while the caterpillar sprouts a long, shaggy coat.
creativeAngle: 把光溜溜的怪物設計成巨型毛毛蟲，先讓牠頭頂冒出四束毛，摔倒時用這四束毛排成字，最後在唸「毛毛蟲」的同時讓牠全身長出長毛。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized toy animation in one locked, wide frontal shot on a matte buttercream moon floor. A tiny spring-legged astronaut doll with molded mittens and a clear fishbowl helmet faces a giant mint-green caterpillar with smooth, shiny segments. Keep the center open above the action for the finished character 毛. Bright soft lighting, clear silhouettes and broad margins.

0.0–1.6 s. The smooth caterpillar dips its head into center frame and four cobalt tufts spring up like a pompadour on the first spoken 毛. At lower left, the astronaut’s eyes widen. It rubs its mittens together, points at the fluffy crest and takes a running step to pat it.

1.6–3.3 s. The astronaut reaches, but its spring boots lift it just above the crest. The caterpillar puffs out its chest, flexes its front feet and charges from right to left underneath. Show the astronaut making one tiny sidestep in midair while the caterpillar brakes with its front feet planted and its rear segments swing straight up.

3.3–4.8 s. Hold the caterpillar almost upright for a split beat, then let it topple backward like a tree toward the lower right with one soft THUMP. Its belly squashes and rebounds into a dazed grin. The floor bounce knocks the four tufts free. Each flips broadside and lands flat against the pale backdrop as a crisp, solid cobalt stroke. On the second spoken 毛 at 4.8 s, they settle into a single correctly formed Traditional Chinese 毛: a short top stroke slanting upward to the right, two separate horizontal strokes below it with the lower one longer, and a continuous vertical stroke crossing both horizontals and sweeping right into an upturned hook.

4.8–8.0 s. Hold 毛 perfectly still, centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height. At 5.6 s, precisely as 毛毛蟲 is spoken, long mint hairs spring out across the same caterpillar from head to tail, turning its smooth body into a shaggy rug in one quick ripple. The astronaut lands gently on its belly and gives a silent, wobbly victory salute. Keep both toys at the lower right, clear of every stroke.

A warm off-screen Taiwanese Mandarin voice says exactly “毛、毛、毛毛蟲” (ㄇㄠˊ、ㄇㄠˊ、ㄇㄠˊ ㄇㄠˊ ㄔㄨㄥˊ). Begin at 0.7, 4.8 and 5.6 seconds respectively. Read each syllable slowly and distinctly with clear second tones and a brief pause before the word. End speech after 蟲. Keep effects soft under the voice. The single 毛 is the only visible text. No subtitles, watermark or flashing effects.
direction: 一個光溜溜的可愛小怪物，全身突然長出很長的毛，範例詞用 毛髮
